about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Style.about: VST3 parameter 0. Host display: 0 = Clean; 2 = Opto; 4 = Mastering; 5 = Bus; 7 = Pumping.

parameters/Auto Release.about: VST3 parameter 7. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Lookahead.about: VST3 parameter 8. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 5 = 5.000 ms; 10 = 10.00 ms; 15 = 15.00 ms; 20 = 20.00 ms.

parameters/Wet Gain.about: VST3 parameter 10. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Wet Pan.about: VST3 parameter 11. Host display: -1 = Mid: 0 dB / Side: -INF dB; -0.5 = Mid: 0 dB / Side: -6.02 dB; 0 = Mid: 0 dB / Side: 0 dB; 0.5 = Mid: -6.02 dB / Side: 0 dB; 1 = Mid: -INF dB / Side: 0 dB.

parameters/Dry Gain.about: VST3 parameter 12. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Dry Pan.about: VST3 parameter 13. Host display: -1 = Mid: 0 dB / Side: -INF dB; -0.5 = Mid: 0 dB / Side: -6.02 dB; 0 = Mid: 0 dB / Side: 0 dB; 0.5 = Mid: -6.02 dB / Side: 0 dB; 1 = Mid: -INF dB / Side: 0 dB.

parameters/Auto Gain.about: VST3 parameter 14. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Side Chain Expert Mode.about: VST3 parameter 15. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Side Chain Input.about: VST3 parameter 16. Host display: 0 = Plug-in Input; 0 = Plug-in Input; 1 = External Input; 1 = External Input; 1 = External Input.

parameters/Stereo Link Mode.about: VST3 parameter 19. Host display: 0 = Mid; 1 = Side; 2 = M -> S; 2 = M -> S; 3 = S -> M.

parameters/Side Chain Low Enabled.about: VST3 parameter 20. Host display: 0 = Disabled; 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled.

parameters/Side Chain Low Slope.about: VST3 parameter 22. Host display: 0 = 6 dB/oct; 2 = 18 dB/oct; 4 = 30 dB/oct; 6 = 48 dB/oct; 8 = 96 dB/oct.

parameters/Side Chain Mid Auto.about: VST3 parameter 23. Host display: 0 = Manual; 0 = Manual; 1 = Auto; 1 = Auto; 1 = Auto.

parameters/Side Chain Mid Enabled.about: VST3 parameter 24. Host display: 0 = Disabled; 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled.

parameters/Side Chain Mid Shape.about: VST3 parameter 28. Host display: 0 = Bell; 1 = Low Shelf; 3 = Notch; 4 = Band Pass; 5 = Tilt Shelf.
